name: Fabbo
tagline: Create AI videos and images from text, photos and templates
description: Fabbo is a browser workspace for AI video and image creation. Start a video from a text prompt, animate a photo, or customize a ready-made template with its prompt already prepared. The same workspace supports image generation and editing. Creators, marketers and small teams can choose different models for different visual projects. New accounts receive free credits; paid plans provide more credits for continued use, and generation costs vary by model and settings.
